newsitem.title: USA: NYPA again shuts Fitzpatrick N.Y. power plant.
newsitem.headline: NYPA again shuts Fitzpatrick N.Y. power plant.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) was forced Sunday to shut its 832 megawatt (MW) James A Fitzpatrick nuclear power plant for repairs while it was trying to bring the unit back on line, the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.

The NRC said the unit was manually tripped off line Sunday after a leak was found in its electrical hydraulical control system, cutting power production back to zero after it reached about 20 percent Friday in the first phase of its restart.
The Fitzpatrick power station, in Scriba, N.Y., was in the process of returning to service after a 47-day scheduled maintenance and refueling outage.
The NRC gave no operator estimate for when the unit likely could be brought back on line.
